hello.speaker: arena-keeper
hello.text: Welcome to the practice yard! Here you can test what you have built before it really matters. What would you like to know?

options.text: How do we talk to people?

talking.speaker: arena-keeper
talking.text: Walk into someone to talk with them. Pick an answer by clicking it or by pressing its number key.

options.text: Got it. How does fighting work?

fighting.speaker: arena-keeper
fighting.text: When a fight starts, everyone rolls for turn order. On your turn, walk up to your speed, then walk into an enemy to attack. Press Space to end your turn early.

bye.speaker: arena-keeper
bye.text: Good luck out there. The sparring bots are waiting!
